podcast.title: Famous Family Members
podcast.body: Mickey Katz, a comedian, is now primarily remembered for his famous family members. His son is Joel Grey, who starred in "Cabaret," and his granddaughter is Jennifer Grey, known for her roles in "Dirty Dancing" and "Ferris Bueller's Day Off." "His son is Joel Gray, the star of Cabaret while his granddaughter Jennifer Gray starred in dirty dancing and Ferris Bull as Day Off."

podcast.title: Jewish Culture Parodies
podcast.body: Katz's comedy involved performing parodies of popular songs, to which he added new lyrics that referenced Jewish culture. An example of this style is his version of "16 Tons," which he reimagined to be about working in a deli rather than a coal mine. "Justice's comedy consisted of him performing parodies of currently popular songs, giving them new lyrics referencing Jewish culture."

podcast.title: Talent Scout for Johnny Otis
podcast.body: Before becoming a comedian, Mickey Katz was a serious musician. After seeing Johnny Otis perform live, Katz recognized Otis's exceptional talent as a bandleader. Being signed to Capital Records himself, Katz called his label and urged them to sign Otis, leading to Otis's first major label distribution in years. "Cats had been a serious musician before he went into comedy and when he went to see Otis perform live, he recognized his talent as a band leader and called his record label, urging them to sign him."
